svg.title: Physical ArduinoISP wiring: Uno 5V, real J1 mating posts and IR ring
svg.desc: Local PCB/CAD views with six separate cable lanes. White Uno 5V to J1.2, grey D12 to J1.1, blue D13 to J1.3, purple D11 to J1.4, brown D10 to J1.5 and black GND to J1.6. Remove CR2032. The 5 V target rail is user-reported working, not a new measured qualification.
svg.metadata: Updated local wiring PDF page 2, SHA256 7538b3cdaa9f23a91cef7c34594b3a2c47241550e8f6461c7297167dd0a2f54d. Fritzing Uno by althaus, CC BY-SA 3.0. Other views use unchanged local CAD meshes. See arduino-isp-reference-sources.json.

text.tspan: PHYSICAL WIRING | Uno ­> programming clip ­> IR ring
Your reported cable colours / COM6. White uses Uno 5V; the target rail is reported working. Remove the CR2032.
DIGITAL header detail: GND beside AREF
Any Uno GND is equivalent. Do not use Uno RESET.
Board fits inside clip; no loose wires to these pads.
TP8 GND is on the other face, against the anvil.
INSIDE CLIP: CONTACTS, NOT MORE WIRES
BLACK internal lead (not shown on CAD): probe J2 ­> anvil J1 ­> P8 / P8L+P8R ­> front TP8.
REMOVE CR2032. White = Uno 5V VCC, matching ISP levels. Reported working; check PCB power/current and heat.
11 Nov 2026 | actual PCB/CAD meshes; jaw/pin geometry still estimated | user­reported COM6 cable colours
Uno illustration: Fritzing / althaus, CC BY­SA 3.0. Local Blender renders: existing Lantern Ring CAD; no fit or electrical qualification.
